blockers.description: Bug B: the bulk reconcile scan throws for one of the 14 active-linked contacts (real Google contacts c3-c6 + 2-link merge survivors c4/c9/c11 included) and the exception is swallowed by ReconcileGridScreen.tsx:229-230, so no trace. Blocks scenarios 4 and 5.
blockers.workaround: Instrument in a debug build: temporarily un-swallow the .catch / log the throwing contactId + stack, build on droid, reproduce 'Check linked contacts', capture the real error, then fix. Per-contact path works, so it is full-set/multi-source/photo-staging specific.

blockers.description: Finding A: renaming a LOCAL (no-account) Android contact changes its lookup key and orphans the Orbit link (exact-string match), so the scenario 3/4 rename-fixtures show 'Source missing' instead of a name conflict.
blockers.workaround: Test conflicts by changing a method VALUE (e.g. edit a phone number) or use a Google-account contact; do NOT rename local fixtures.

decisions.decision: ADR-003: enable READ_CONTACTS on API 37+ for the reconcile re-read (lift the maxSdkVersion=36 cap at BOTH the module manifest AND plugins/withContactPickerPermission.js — the plugin wins the app-manifest merge). Import stays permissionless. Owner-approved 2026-08-31 after verifying the current Play policy allows it via declaration for the CRM category.
decisions.rationale: Reconcile reads the live state of already-linked contacts, which the one-shot system picker cannot serve. Supersedes ADR-002's 'no READ_CONTACTS on API 37' clause.

decisions.decision: Delegate all device driving + droid builds to bounded per-task subagents; the orchestrator verifies every DB claim against the live database and never trusts a subagent summary.
decisions.rationale: Keeps orchestrator context lean; matches the owner's request and the non-opaque-delegation constraint.
